title: sambucus nigra subsp. maderensis
intro: Sambucus nigra subsp. maderensis, commonly known as Madeiran elder, is a subspecies of the Sambucus nigra plant, which is a type of flowering plant in the honeysuckle family (Caprifoliaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate respiratory issues, and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Madeiran elder are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Madeiran elder contribute to its ability to support the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu.
